overview_description.description:
Wallbit is a global neobank offering USD and EUR accounts, debit cards, access to US investments and local currencies — all in one app.

Users can open USD and EUR accounts, receive international payments, spend globally with virtual and physical debit cards, invest in US stocks, ETFs, and bonds, and withdraw funds in local currencies.

Wallbit is designed for individuals living outside the US who need access to global banking. Key use cases include:

- Remote workers and freelancers receiving income from abroad
- Individuals in emerging markets seeking to save in USD to protect their wealth from inflation
- Individuals looking for simple, direct access to the US investment market due to lack of investment options in their country of residence

Core features:

- Personal USD and EUR accounts
- International and local transfers
- Virtual and physical debit cards
- Investment accounts with access to US markets
- Real-time currency conversion and stablecoins support
- Local payouts and bill payments

Wallbit combines global banking, investing, and local usability into a single, all-in-one app.

about_short_description.short_description: Wallbit is a global neobank available in 50+ countries, supporting USD and EUR accounts, cards, investment features and local currencies.

product.name: Global Dollar Account
product.description: A U.S.-based bank account allowing users to receive payments and transfers in U.S. dollars from anywhere worldwide.

product.name: International Visa Card
product.description: A Visa debit card issued in the U.S. that allows users to pay in local currencies in over 180 countries.

product.name: Investment Account
product.description: An investment platform allowing users to invest from $1 in U.S. stocks, ETFs, and Treasury bonds with SIPC protection.

product.name: Currency Exchange and Local Withdrawals
product.description: Service enabling users to convert dollars to local currencies and withdraw funds to local bank accounts at competitive exchange rates.

product.name: Wallbit Paid Account
product.description: An interest-bearing account that invests user funds in U.S. government instruments to generate returns.
